jobs.description: OUR COMPANYAt Boehringer Ingelheim we develop breakthrough therapies and innovative healthcare solutions in areas of unmet medical need for both humans and animals. academic research institutions, contract research organizations and other HEOR thought leaders in order to optimize the impact of HEOR & PRO research.Additional responsibilities as Senior Manager:- addition, you will draft long-term publication strategies, considering the long-term global market development.Requirements- Graduate degree, preferably PhD in health economics, Medicine (MD), public health, pharmacy, focusing on Health Technology Assessment, PRO, Pharmacy, Medicine, Public Health- Several years of pharma industry experience, with positions in areas of relevance for HEOR, PRO pharmaceutical products- Conducting or being part of a team working on non-interventional studies and RWE programs- Demonstrated experience of successful regulatory, reimbursement negotiations for launching new products in key markets- Proven track record of delivering value demonstration materials that resulted in timely patient access and adoption- Proven ability in appraising clinical evidence (both RCTs and operational evidence)- Profound knowledge and expertise to formulating COA strategies including validation methods, administration of measures and statistical analyses of COA data- Excellent communication and influencing skill both in internal and external contextAdditional requirements as Senior HEOR Manager:- Long-term pharma industry experience, with positions in the areas of health economics, pricing & reimbursement, consulting, or payer authorities- Several years of exposure to international business on a day-to-day basis- Strong track record in value priority. jobs.description: Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.comThe PositionAs Senior Global Medical Manager Immuno-Oncology, you will contribute scientific and medical leadership to the global medical strategy for an early oncology brand. Reporting to the Brand Head Immuno-Oncology, you will be accountable for defined medical deliverables that prepare the asset and healthcare ecosystem for future clinical adoption and patient access. Working in a global matrix, including close collaboration with the Pipeline Medical Affairs Lead, you will translate scientific evidence, external insights and unmet needs into focused medical strategies, evidence-generation plans and measurable outcomes that help close relevant care gaps.Tasks & responsibilities- Contribute to the development and continuous refinement of the global medical strategy, translating strategic priorities, unmet needs and care gaps into clearly defined medical deliverables and outcome measures.- Take end-to-end accountability for the strategic direction, quality and timely delivery of major medical deliverables. Experience in colorectal cancer (CRC), pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) and/or breast cancer is highly desirable.- Proven experience contributing to global medical strategy and leading complex medical workstreams for oncology assets, including medical launch preparation or indication expansion.- Demonstrated track record in shaping and delivering Medical Affairs-led evidence generation, including the identification and prioritization of evidence gaps, development of study concepts, oversight of study delivery and translation of results into decision-relevant medical insights.- Established collaboration with international oncology experts, scientific societies, research networks and other stakeholders across the healthcare ecosystem, with the ability to convert external perspectives into strategic recommendations and action.- Strong matrix leadership, strategic judgment and execution discipline, with the ability to lead through influence, align diverse stakeholders and deliver high-quality outcomes in a complex global environment. ESMC steht fürdas gemeinsame Engagement zur Stärkung des europäischenHalbleiter-Ökosystems. Für unsere zukünftige Fab in Dresden suchenwir eine/n hochmotivierte/n und engagierte/n: System EngineerCleanroom / Systemingenieur Reinraumtechnik (m/f/d) Join ESMC at apivotal moment as we build one of Europe’s most advancedsemiconductor manufacturing facilities. As a System EngineerCleanroom, you will play a key role in bringing critical cleanroomsystems into operation and ensuring their long-term performance,reliability and compliance. This position offers the uniqueopportunity to combine technical ownership with the excitement of agreenfield project in an international high-tech environment. TasksTake ownership of cleanroom-related systems and ensure their reliable,safe and compliant operation. Monitor and optimise system performanceto maintain cleanroom conditions and maximise system availability.Lead troubleshooting activities and drive sustainable solutionsthrough structured root cause analysis. Coordinate maintenanceactivities and collaborate closely with technicians and externalservice providers. Support the transition from fab construction intostable manufacturing operations. Identify and implement continuousimprovement initiatives to enhance reliability, efficiency andoperational performance. Profile Must Have: Bachelor’s or Master’sdegree in Mechanical Engineering, Facility Engineering, EnvironmentalEngineering or a related technical discipline. Several years ofprofessional experience working with cleanroom environments orcomparable highly controlled technical facilities. Experience in theoperation, commissioning or optimization of complex technical systems.A structured and analytical approach to troubleshooting andproblem-solving. Strong communication skills and the ability tocollaborate effectively with technicians, service providers andcross-functional teams. Fluent German and English language skills(minimum C1 level in both languages). Willingness to participate ininternational training assignments during the onboarding phase (up to3 months in Taiwan). We offer Security & Perspective: A permanentemployment contract and career advancement opportunities in one ofEurope's leading semiconductors fabs.
